observations.title: Startup-persistence scanner rule matched purely presentational stylesheet rules
observations.technical_explanation: All eight candidates point into a contiguous block of stylesheet rules that define the look of an in-app profile-image cropping dialog: the image frame, preview image sizing, dimming overlay, draggable crop ring, its active-state pointer, inner guide, resize knob, and the button row. Every flagged line contains only visual declarations. Stylesheets in this project carry no script execution, storage access, network requests, or startup registration, so a persistence/startup-modification rule cannot correspond to real behavior here; the matches appear to be pattern-driven false positives on styling keywords.
observations.layman_explanation: A scanning tool flagged these lines as suspicious startup-related behavior, but the lines only describe how a picture-cropping window looks in the app. Styling code cannot run programs, save data, or change how the computer starts up, so nothing harmful is present.
